thread:
maria: Deploy finished canary->prod for v2.14.1 at 23:02 UTC. Kicking off post-deploy smoke: burstbackfill + synth probes across eu/us. Please monitor kv-prefill and embed-route latencies.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: service=inference-api, image=redwood/inference:v2.14.1, mode=staggered, postdeploy-smoke=started. synth-agent jobs queued.

devon: seeing p95 jump on synth-burst in eu-west1 — baseline ~380ms -> just hit ~1.2s for last 30s. 5xx count went 0 -> 2.

aj: can you paste the failing probe lines? I want to check tokenization path vs quant variant.

devon: logs snippet: ```[2026-03-23T23:03:10Z] synth-probe-burst id=fb-9a, lat=1230ms, status=200
[2026-03-23T23:03:12Z] synth-probe-burst id=fb-9b, lat=1185ms, status=200
[2026-03-23T23:03:13Z] synth-probe-burst id=fb-9c, lat=1258ms, status=500```

sarah: also saw a small kv-prefill miss spike; kv-warmup p50 still fine but p95 jumped. Might be cold host warmups overlapping with burstbackfill.

maria: okay hold the global ramp. We'll pause the staggered rollout and keep canary traffic at current bucket. aj, please prepare to pin eu routes to last stable (v2.13.9) if numbers don't improve in 10m. No infra rollback yet.

opsbot: synth-agent report: burstbackfill job=fb-9 summary: samples=120, slow_samples=3, errors=1, mean_lat=410ms, p95=980ms.

aj: running pin now for eu region to v2.13.9 (dry-run then apply). CLI: ```rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-west1 --from v2.14.1 --to v2.13.9 --reason "postdeploy p95 spike" --ticket none```

deploy-bot: action=route-pin status=applied service=inference-api region=eu-west1 pinned_to=v2.13.9 actor=aj ts=3291234720

devon: after pin p95 for synth-burst back down to ~420ms in eu-west1, 5xx returned to 0. We'll keep sampling for another 10m.

maria: good catch. Decision: hold the rest of the rollout for 1 hour, add a note to the release entry that eu was pinned due to postdeploy synth p95 spike. If errors exceed 10% or p95 increases >20% from baseline, open an incident.

sarah: filing release notes addendum and adding the pin + reason to the change window doc. :thumbsup:

aj: ack, I'll schedule a controlled re-roll at low-traffic window tonight after we validate warmup behavior in a canary bucket.

maria: thanks everyone. Quick checklist: 1) keep canary bucket at current weight 2) monitor kv-prefill p95 and synth probe p95 3) ops to escalate if error threshold hit.

sarah: noted, will update the release notes and ops pager doc.

maria: closing thread for now — will reopen if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
